versions.change: Beta             Second issue, for ADIv5.0 to ADIv5.2.
Final        Third issue, for ADIv5.0 to ADIv5.2.

backward_compat_traps.rule: Bit 0 of DPIDR shall be hard-wired to 1 (RAO).
backward_compat_traps.trap: If forgotten, host cannot distinguish stuck-at-zero SWDIO from a real DPIDR readout.
Custom IPs mishandling Park=1 lose Turnaround margin.

backward_compat_traps.rule: ACK shall be OK=001 / WAIT=010 / FAULT=100 (one-hot).
backward_compat_traps.trap: Returning 000 / 011 / 111 confuses every commercial debug probe.

backward_compat_traps.rule: Line reset requires ≥ 50 consecutive SWDIO=HIGH cycles.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Implementations accepting fewer cycles break hosts that follow spec.

backward_compat_traps.rule: Both SWJ-DP selection sequences (0xE79E and 0xE73C) shall be shifted LSB-first.
backward_compat_traps.trap: MSB-first shift never switches modes — classic CMSIS-DAP port bug.

backward_compat_traps.rule: Final read of an AP burst shall be recovered via DP.RDBUFF.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Forgetting trailing RDBUFF read gives next-to-last result — off-by-one.

backward_compat_traps.rule: MEM-AP TAR auto-increment shall wrap within a 4 KB page (or per CFG.LongAddress).
backward_compat_traps.trap: Ignoring wrap-around boundary corrupts cross-page bursts.

fields.ic_name: ARM Serial Wire Debug (SWD) — ADIv5 (ARM IHI 0031C)
fields.spec_version: ARM IHI 0031C — ARM Debug Interface v5 Architecture Specification (ADIv5). Documents ADIv5.0 + ADIv5.1 + ADIv5.2 amendments.
previous_versions: ARM Debug Interface v4 (ADIv4) — predates CoreSight; JTAG-only.
post_primer_evolution_industry_note: IEEE Std 1149.1-2001 — major revision; mandatory IDCODE (when Device ID register is present), tightened BSDL, post-1990 cleanup.
IEEE Std 1149.1-2013 — further revision; programmable test access (PDL), BSDL packaging, ICL/PDL Tcl-bindings via IEEE 1687 IJTAG.
IEEE Std 1149.4 — Mixed-Signal Test Bus (analog boundary scan, layered on 1149.1).
IEEE Std 1149.6 — Advanced I/O test (AC-coupled and differential pin testing).
IEEE Std 1149.7 — Compact JTAG (cJTAG); 2-pin reduction of 1149.1.
IEEE Std 1687-2014 — Internal JTAG (IJTAG); standardized hierarchical instrument access on top of 1149.1.
ARM JTAG-DP / SWD — ARM CoreSight debug access port; layered on 1149.1 (or 2-pin Serial Wire Debug).

key_changes.summary: Base spec: 4-pin JTAG-DP + 2-pin SW-DP + SWJ-DP; DP register set; AP layer; MEM-AP + JTAG-AP.
Adds TARGETID + DLPIDR + EVENTSTAT in DP higher banks.
Multi-drop SWD; long-address TAR (64-bit); large-data DRW.
Successor: 64-bit address; hierarchical ROM Tables; new AP classes.

fields.version_naming_history_note: SWD is the 2-pin variant of the ARM Debug Interface defined by ADIv5 (ARM IHI 0031C, first released 2006). CoreSight is the umbrella debug-IP family. ADIv6 (Arm IHI 0074) is the named successor.
post_adiv5_evolution_industry_note: CMSIS-DAP — Arm's open USB-to-SWD/JTAG probe reference firmware.
